scoring_formula.description: Each of the 9 pillars is scored from 0 to 100. Raw pillar weights sum to 115 and are normalized to 100%: Overall = round(sum(pillar_score * weight_raw) / 115).

severity_model.reach_definition: Share of crawled HTML pages affected (0.0 to 1.0), or 1.0 for site-wide rules.
